comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Test code and types that say what they mean
themes.text: `#[TestOnly]` marks a class or a method as test code. `nvs run` and `nvs build` leave it out, and code outside the tests cannot use it. A value tested with `is static` can be returned where the method returns `static`.

themes.title: Read large folders and files in a loop
themes.text: `Core\IO::walk` reads one folder at a time, and each entry says if it is a file or a folder. `Core\IO::lines` reads its file while the loop runs. A listing shows only what the program may read. `Core\Path::matches` tests a path against a pattern.

themes.title: The same TLS settings for every client
themes.text: The database, LDAP, mail and Redis clients take the same TLS settings as `Core\Http\Client`. You can trust a private certificate for one host. Each setting needs a host entry under `[capabilities.tls]` in `nvs.toml`.

themes.title: Send and receive files over FTP, FTPS and SFTP
themes.text: `Core\FileTransfer::open` connects to a server that the person who runs the program configures in `nvs.toml`. The same code works with FTP, FTPS, SFTP and a local folder. In tests, the folder replaces the server.

themes.title: Write HTML attributes from a map
themes.text: `Core\Html::attributes` writes a map of attributes and escapes every value. A value that is `true` writes the bare name, and `false` or `null` leaves the attribute out. It leaves out an unsafe URL. `Core\Html::mergeAttributes` merges sets of attributes, and joins the `class` and `style` lists.

themes.title: Read Outlook messages
themes.text: `Core\Mail\Message::parse` reads an Outlook `.msg` file, a `winmail.dat` attachment, signed S/MIME mail and uuencoded files. The result is the same `Core\Mail\Message` that an ordinary email gives.
